title: Meta Pixel, Conversions API (CAPI) & Event Deduplication
overview: Meta Conversions API creates a direct, server-to-server connection between marketing data and Meta systems to optimize ad delivery, measure outcomes, and decrease cost per action post-cookie loss.
coreConcepts: Redundant event collection: Browser Pixel (fbq) paired with Server-Side CAPI
Event Deduplication key: matching event_name + event_id between browser and server payloads
Event Match Quality (EMQ): evaluated from 0 to 10 based on hashed customer parameters (em, ph, fn, ln, ct, zp, country)
Meta Aggregated Event Measurement (AEM) protocol for iOS 14.5+ attribution
features: Batch event uploading supporting up to 1,000 events per HTTP request
Test Events Tool inside Meta Events Manager for real-time payload debugging
Automatic Advanced Matching for enhanced browser-side parameter capture
bestPractices: Always generate a unique UUIDv4 event_id on the server and pass it down to both fbq() and CAPI
Hash all personal identifiers using lowercase SHA-256 before transmitting
Pass client_user_agent and client_ip_address with all server events
Aim for an Event Match Quality score >= 8.0 on Purchase and Lead events
policies: Meta Health Advertising Policy: Never transmit sensitive medical data or health symptoms
Prohibition on passing plaintext credit card numbers, passwords, or government IDs
Explicit user consent required where mandated by regional privacy regulations (GDPR/DMA)
limitations: CAPI event ingestion latency: typically within seconds, maximum 7 days backdated
Server events without client_ip_address or client_user_agent suffer lower match quality
Meta Graph API token requires renewal every 60 days unless System User token is used
commonIssues: Duplicate purchase reporting caused by missing event_id deduplication keys
Low Event Match Quality (< 6.0) due to passing only client IP without hashed email or phone
401 Unauthorized errors caused by expired user access tokens

troubleshootingGuide.issue: Events reported twice in Ads Manager
troubleshootingGuide.resolution: Verify that fbq('track', 'Purchase', {...}, {eventID: id}) and CAPI payload pass the exact same string in event_id
Generate a permanent System User token inside Meta Business Manager instead of temporary user tokens
